summary: Our project is a Twister game about Mars. We wanted to create a fun way for students to learn more about this planet. In our game, students move, play, and answer questions while learning interesting facts about Mars.We chose Twister because we wanted to make something more active than a normal presentation or board game. Our project helps students learn about space in an easy and entertaining way. It also encourages teamwork and participation.We think this project is important because learning about space doesn't have to be boring. With our game, students can have fun while discovering new things about Mars and science.
details: Our project is a Mars Twister game, it is an interactive game that helps kids learn more about mars having fun. Our game includes questions and facts about mars, so they can learn and study two. The main benefit is that kids can learn about space in a fun and different way, we want our project make kids more interested in space, mars and science. Our project is creative because we turned a a normal twister to a space education game and also we made it colored and fun.
